title: Zechariah Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on Zechariah 8: Yahweh's return to Zion, old men and children in the streets, and the nations who come to seek him.

questions.text: With what does Yahweh of Armies say he is jealous for Zion?
questions.explanation: Yahweh of Armies says, "I am jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I am jealous for her with great wrath."

answers.text: With great jealousy and great wrath

questions.text: What name does Yahweh say Jerusalem shall be called?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he has returned to Zion and will dwell in the middle of Jerusalem, and Jerusalem shall be called "The City of Truth".

questions.text: Who will again dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, each with a staff in his hand?
questions.explanation: Yahweh of Armies says old men and old women will again dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, every man with his staff in his hand for very age.

questions.text: With whom will the streets of the city be full?
questions.explanation: The streets of the city will be full of boys and girls playing in its streets.

questions.text: From which countries does Yahweh say he will save his people?
questions.explanation: Yahweh of Armies says he will save his people from the east country and from the west country, and bring them to dwell within Jerusalem.

answers.text: From the north and the south
From the east and the west
From the sea and from the river

questions.text: What will the heavens give, in the promise about the seed and the vine?
questions.explanation: The vine will yield its fruit, the ground will give its increase, and the heavens will give their dew.

questions.text: What does Yahweh say the house of Judah and the house of Israel will become?
questions.explanation: As they were a curse among the nations, so he will save them, and they shall be a blessing; they are told not to be afraid and to let their hands be strong.

questions.text: What are the people told to speak with their neighbor?
questions.explanation: These are the things they shall do: speak every man the truth with his neighbor, and execute the judgment of truth and peace in their gates.

questions.text: What will the fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh and tenth months become for the house of Judah?
questions.explanation: Yahweh of Armies says these fasts shall be for the house of Judah joy and gladness, and cheerful feasts; therefore they are to love truth and peace.

answers.text: Days of silence in the temple
Joy and gladness, and cheerful feasts

questions.text: What will the ten men say as they take hold of the skirt of him who is a Jew?
questions.explanation: Out of all the languages of the nations ten men will take hold of his skirt, saying, "We will go with you, for we have heard that God is with you."

answers.text: We will go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.
Teach us the words of the law of your God.
Give us a place to dwell in your city.
Pray for us in the house of your God.
